svg.title: MiniMax-H3 H200 speedup comparison
svg.desc: Four panels compare speedup against the matching Diffusers case for T2VA and FL2VA at five and ten seconds on eight H200 GPUs.
svg.text: Speedup versus the matching Diffusers case (higher is better)
The orange-red bars are the Cache-DiT + SubBlock combinations; the fastest tested mode is 0.80 + Cache-DiT stride
